title: Silent semantic failure — exit_code=0 + rules pass, but output is logically wrong
description: The most corrosive false positive. Trace records success because exit_code=0 and all validation rules pass, but the resolver misunderstood the goal and produced semantically wrong output (e.g., LLM resolver hallucinated a function name, file was written with placeholder text, refactor removed wrong call site). Thompson α increments incorrectly; future recommendations degrade silently. Detection requires downstream task contradiction or human verdict — the live trace alone cannot distinguish.

preconditions: task uses LLM-tier resolver or any resolver where output correctness is not strictly syntactic
task declares only syntactic validation rules (requiredFiles, forbiddenPatterns) without semantic check
downstream task consumes the output but does not immediately fail (consumes shape, not content semantics)

traces.synthesize: Pick the 10 most-recent successful LLM-resolver task executions; for each, replay the same input impulses and compare output. Diverging output indicates a candidate silent-semantic-failure trace.

goal_text: Identify executions in the last 7 days where the recorded outcome was success but a re-execution against the same input impulses produces materially different output. Flag those as candidate silent-semantic-failures and propose a semantic-validation activity that gates future executions of the affected templates.

detection.signal: Two traces with same input_impulse_ids signature and same template_id, but materially different output_impulse content (Levenshtein distance > 0.4 on text, structural diff on JSON).
detection.query_template: SELECT id, activity_id, input_impulses, output_impulses, success, created_at FROM execution WHERE created_at > time::now() - 7d AND success = true AND activity_id IN (SELECT activity_id FROM execution WHERE created_at > time::now() - 7d GROUP BY activity_id, input_impulses HAVING count() > 1) ORDER BY activity_id, input_impulses, created_at DESC

recovery_test.regression_query: After the semantic-validator activity is shipped, re-run the trigger and verify it now classifies the planted silent-failure as a failure_mode='verifier_negative' on subsequent executions of the affected template.

subagent_investigation.findings_summary: Trace storage splits across two tables: `execution` (input_impulses, output_impulses as ID arrays) and `impulse` (content, optional/often null). Output content is NOT materialized on the trace; must be fetched per-impulse and may be unavailable. executionTraceWithSignatures returns impulses_by_id with shape+summary but not raw content or input-signature hash. Migration 115 introduced `execution_trace_content` table with full output_impulses arrays. No replay-and-compare activity exists.
current_gaps_in_codebase: No input-signature fingerprint field on execution rows; cannot GROUP BY input signature deterministically
Output content is in impulse.content (often null); no guaranteed materialization on trace
No replay resolver that accepts (template_id, input_impulse_ids) and re-executes for divergence check
